summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a September 30, 2026 Joint Venture and Operating Agreement with Nasdaq-listed Sadot Group Inc. and newly formed CMJV LLC, establishing a 50/50 Nevada joint venture to hold VisionWave's rights relating to C.M. Composite Materials Ltd. and to act as lender ahead of a pending acquisition. The underlying February 20, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement, as amended, would give VisionWave 51% of CM for 250,000 VisionWave shares, with a call option on the remaining 49%. The Belrise joint-venture condition remains unsatisfied, and long-stop and outside closing dates were extended to December 31, 2026. VisionWave has advanced roughly $7.81 million at 12% interest, secured by a first-priority lien on substantially all CM assets. Watch the Belrise condition, closing certainty, and 50/50 governance friction.
